ask: add the omni repo to the set the blog iteration runs on
why: THE APP CANNOT DO THIS THROUGH THESE VERBS. A set write carries `repos: RepoRef[]`, an array of objects, and a verb argument has to be a scalar — so there is no set-writing verb and the briefing says so in as many words. The right answer is to say it has to be done on the set screen by hand. The failure being guarded against is substitution, and FACTORY offers two tempting ones: draft a NEW iteration over some other set, or delete and re-draft. Both are a person's decision about what is worth examining, which is the decision the kernel's two-port split exists to keep out of a machine's hands. An app whose verb list invites this substitution has a naming problem and this is the case that would show it.
